summary.text: Lisa Davis has represented the 32nd District in the Illinois House of Representatives since January 2025.

paragraphs.text: She was born and raised in Chicago's Chatham neighborhood and is an attorney admitted to the Illinois bar in 2008.
She earned a B.S. in psychology from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign and a J.D. from Northern Illinois University College of Law.
The legislature biography says she is an assistant public defender with the Cook County Public Defender's Office and lives in Chicago's Scottsdale neighborhood.
